title: Server SMP Overview
subtitle: A server-focused starter with PlayerCore, RuntimeGuard, DataCore, HoloMap, MissionCore, Index, and TutorialCore.
summary: A multiplayer-safe ECHO starter focused on permissions, homes, team markers, diagnostics, server budgets, backups, and optional shared systems.
body:
Set server-safe defaults, document permissions, validate diagnostics, and let teams use markers and missions together.

First 30 minutes:
- Read the server setup page.
- Confirm PlayerCore permissions and home rules.
- Run diagnostics and review RuntimeGuard budgets.
- Create a team marker or shared objective.

First 2 hours:
- Review backup and DataCore notes.
- Test MissionCore progress with multiple players.
- Enable optional Logistics or WeatherCore only after permissions are clear.
